description: AGSC-09-16: the Bundle a page serves is the PUBLISHED projection of AGSC-06-30, so an item that is not published is invisible to a page tool and the page tool answers AGSC-E301 for it, exactly as the local server answers for a slug that does not exist. Derivation: `alpha` is stable and published, so both transports return the same value (AGSC-09-16's equality is over values, not bytes); `beta` is draft, so AGSC-06-30 excludes it from every published surface, the local MCP server reading the Bundle still answers it, and the page tool, which can read only what was published, returns the AGSC-09-13a error envelope with code AGSC-E301. Without the projection, requiring the two transports to agree for the same Bundle would be unsatisfiable on every Bundle holding a draft.
